report: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2020 Prelims Paper-I
method: Every question re-read and answered independently; printed key compared against the answer; explanations rebuilt with a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning, revision facts, takeaway).

questions.subject: Economy
questions.note: Diamond production in India is indeed confined to the Panna belt of Madhya Pradesh, which makes C the only workable option, but the phrase "only found in Madhya Pradesh" overstates the geology: kimberlite occurrences are known in Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh too, without working mines. The answer stands; the wording does not.
